meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: Claude 能基于你的历史观察数据构建专门的“知识库”语料库,把它加载进对话会话,之后你就可以自然提问,它会根据语料库内容回答。还可以列出、重建、重新加载这些知识库。
howto.when: 当你想从自己的观察历史中建立某个主题的专属知识库、询问过去的工作模式,或针对特定议题整理专业知识时,会被触发。

say.text: 查询知识库 hooks-expertise:有哪些生命周期钩子,分别何时触发?
say.note: Claude 会基于该语料库内容回答你的问题。

say.text: 重建 hooks-expertise 知识库,加入最近的新观察。
say.note: 重建后需要重新加载才能使用新内容。

howto.what_en: Claude can build focused 'brains' from your observation history, load them into a conversation, and answer questions from that corpus. It can also list, rebuild, and reprime these knowledge bases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to create a topic-specific knowledge base from observations, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a subject.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base about the hooks lifecycle, named hooks-expertise.
say_en.note: It will build the corpus first; you can query it after.

say_en.text: Query the hooks-expertise KB: what are the lifecycle hooks and when does each fire?
say_en.note: Claude will answer from the corpus.

say_en.text: Rebuild the hooks-expertise KB with recent observations.
say_en.note: Rebuild first, then reprime to use updated content.
